context: The branch already carries an approved on-screen prototype (templates, static CSS, demo seed, and untested view/url/menu Python). The templates, markup and wording were approved by the maintainer and are NOT under review. The plan removes the prototype's Python (T001) and rebuilds it test-first. spec.md was refined after the prototype review: the document page's layout is in scope (decisions.md D1) and FR-019 was added; both were asked for by the maintainer.
orchestrator_question: Verify against the RESOLVED packages, both sides of each rule: (1) flex_menu drops a MenuItem whose view_name does not reverse (research cites flex_menu/menu.py:518) and nothing else on AccountCenterMenu processing raises when mvp_compliance.urls is not mounted; (2) MountedApp.claiming_menu (mvp/mounted.py:286) really makes a page served from another app's URLs draw the account area's sidebar when the entry is selected, and what happens on that page when mvp.urls is NOT mounted; (3) the plan's 404-in-dispatch for a project without the account area: does LoginRequiredMixin's dispatch run first in the MRO and redirect an anonymous visitor before the 404, contradicting T012; (4) adding a validator to Document.slug: does makemigrations produce a migration, and does tests/test_migrations.py or ADR 0004 object; (5) is narrowing TestNoMenuEntry (decisions.md D2) faithful to FS-006 FR-014; (6) FR-015: is two queries really constant given select_related and the template's use of acceptance.version.status and entry.document; (7) anything in the plan with no spec provenance.
